moves.name: Shoulder bounce
moves.how: Knees soft, bounce on the beat and let your shoulders rise and drop, alternating sides.

moves.name: Ek-hath-upar
moves.how: One hand up, palm open, the other low; switch hands every beat.

moves.name: Do-hath-upar / Balle-balle
moves.how: Both arms up over your head, wrists turning, with a bounce.

moves.name: Thumka
moves.how: A small hip thrust to one side on the beat, with a flick of the wrist.

moves.name: Step-touch
moves.how: Step right, tap left beside it; step left, tap right. Add a clap.

moves.name: Chakkar
moves.how: A spin on the spot, one hand up, finishing on the beat.

moves.name: Light bulb
moves.how: Twist one hand above your head as if screwing in a bulb, and bounce.

moves.name: Pat the dog
moves.how: Alternate hands pushing down and patting the air in front of you.

moves.name: Swag walk
moves.how: Slow confident walk, chin up, shoulders rolling, one hand pointing to the crowd.

moves.name: Garba three-clap
moves.how: Step, clap, clap, clap while circling in a group.

combos.name: Bhangra basics
combos.counts: 1) shoulder bounce ×4. 2) ek-hath-upar ×4. 3) thumka and a small jump. 4) balle-balle arms on the drop.

combos.name: Swag freestyle
combos.counts: 1) head-nod bounce ×4. 2) swag walk ×4 steps. 3) chest pop and point. 4) light bulb or pat the dog on the drop.

combos.name: Bollywood party
combos.counts: 1) step-touch ×4. 2) clap. 3) hands-up sway ×4. 4) chakkar and thumka.

combos.name: Couple sway
combos.counts: 1) hold hands, sway ×4. 2) twirl your partner. 3) step forward and back together. 4) finish with a soft dip or forehead touch.

combos.name: Sangeet sway
combos.counts: 1) hip sway ×4 with wrist circles. 2) chakkar. 3) hand-to-cheek shy pose. 4) circle clap with the group.

combos.name: Retro filmi
combos.counts: 1) disco point, arm up diagonally ×4. 2) hip shake. 3) hand wave. 4) turn.

combos.name: Garba
combos.counts: Three-clap garba in a circle: step-clap-clap-clap, twirl on the chorus.

combos.name: Gidda
combos.counts: Clap, bend, push your hands side to side, turn in a circle.
